system_prompt: You are an expert AI coding assistant. Be concise and precise. When using tools, execute them directly and report results briefly. Focus on code quality, correctness, and best practices.

perplexity.name: Perplexity AI
perplexity.system_prompt: You have two capabilities: (1) NATIVE WEB SEARCH for research, facts, and current information - use this automatically for questions and cite sources as markdown links. (2) EXTERNAL TOOLS for file operations, shell commands, and editing - when tools are available and the user asks to DO something (cd, ls, edit, fix, run, create, analyze), execute the appropriate tool immediately instead of explaining how. For actions: act first, report results briefly. For questions: search and cite. Never tell the user to do manually what a tool can do.

sonar.name: Sonar
sonar.description: Lightweight search model with real-time grounding
sonar.__comment_best_for: Quick file operations, simple edits, list/read tasks, directory navigation

sonar-pro.name: Sonar Pro
sonar-pro.description: Advanced search model for complex queries
sonar-pro.__comment_best_for: Complex refactoring, multi-file changes, architecture decisions, code review, debugging. Best all-around model for agentic coding tasks (73.4% benchmark).

sonar-reasoning-pro.name: Sonar Reasoning Pro
sonar-reasoning-pro.description: Precision reasoning with Chain of Thought capabilities (DeepSeek-R1)
sonar-reasoning-pro.__comment_best_for: Algorithm design, bug root cause analysis, test generation, complex logic
sonar-reasoning-pro.__comment_warning: Poor tool calling (50% benchmark) and code editing (28.6%) - avoid for agentic tasks that require direct tool execution

sonar-deep-research.name: Sonar Deep Research
sonar-deep-research.description: Exhaustive research with comprehensive reports (Async Jobs API)
sonar-deep-research.__comment_best_for: Comprehensive documentation, multi-step research, technical writing
sonar-deep-research.__comment_note: Uses Jobs API with reasoning_effort parameter (low/medium/high), not chat completions

capabilities.__comment_native_tool_calling: Perplexity uses prompt-based tool calling (not native API)
